about: Open Autonomy's model rail (open-autonomy 0841076bed91, packages/backend/src/proxy.ts and routes.ts), which forwards its workers' stock-SDK model calls to Gateway with MODEL_GATEWAY_API_KEY as a bearer token: the catalog paged by cursor, the Hermes worker's streamed chat completion on zai/glm-5.3-flash with the stream's usage and cost (the unchanged openai 6.26.0, the version @mariozechner/pi-ai 0.73.1 pins for the openai-completions provider Volter Editor's Pi calls Gateway with), and Claude Code's streamed Messages turn on the same model with a tool call and its result (the unchanged @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.115.0); the World's organization, made after Anthropic's access cutoff, sees Anthropic's models listed as access-required. The twin runs no model: each turn is its labelled deterministic stub, asserted as a stub, so the entry proves the wires, the SDKs' parse and the cost the rail settles with, never an answer's quality.

retention.none: A model call is answered, not stored: Gateway's model API reads nothing back (no call list, and the organization's credit and spend are the dashboard's, src/manifest.ts); the key the credential door issued is the one record the client holds, and the walk resumes the World on it.
